test_flip: test the flip function that reverses tensor batch order along the first dimension
test_min_clip: test the min_clip function that gets maximum values along rows or columns of a tensor
test_max_clip: test the max_clip function that gets minimum values along rows or columns of a tensor
test_normalize: test the normalize function that scales tensor values to a specified range like 0 to 1 or 0 to 255
test_pandas_col_to_numpy: test the pandas_col_to_numpy function that converts a pandas DataFrame column to a numpy array
